# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
# Карточки v2: многослойная живопись - фон с лучом, ореол, тень под субъектом,
# тёмный низ/светлый верх у фигур, блики-спекуляры, виньетка, двойная рамка-камея
import os

OUT = "ui/cards"
os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)

RAR = {
    "common":    ("#43454f", "#2a2b33", "#17181d", "#93959f"),
    "uncommon":  ("#3a5c37", "#22381f", "#121e11", "#72d97c"),
    "rare":      ("#31518a", "#1d3050", "#101a2c", "#6ea8ff"),
    "legendary": ("#7a5518", "#452f0b", "#241805", "#ffbe45"),
}

def header(r):
    c1, c2, c3, border = RAR[r]
    return f'''<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="128" height="128" viewBox="0 0 128 128">
<defs>
<linearGradient id="bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
<stop offset="0" stop-color="{c1}"/><stop offset="0.55" stop-color="{c2}"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="{c3}"/>
</linearGradient>
<radialGradient id="halo" cx="0.5" cy="0.5" r="0.5">
<stop offset="0" stop-color="{border}" stop-opacity="0.5"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="{border}" stop-opacity="0"/>
</radialGradient>
<radialGradient id="vig" cx="0.5" cy="0.42" r="0.75">
<stop offset="0.55" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0.42"/>
</radialGradient>
<linearGradient id="beam" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
<stop offset="0" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0.10"/><stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0"/>
</linearGradient>
<linearGradient id="metal" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
<stop offset="0" stop-color="#e8e8ec"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#8a8a92"/>
</linearGradient>
</defs>'''

def frame(r):
    c1, c2, c3, border = RAR[r]
    return f'''
<rect x="2.5" y="2.5" width="123" height="123" rx="13" fill="none" stroke="{border}" stroke-width="3"/>
<rect x="7" y="7" width="114" height="114" rx="9" fill="none" stroke="{border}" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.45"/>
<circle cx="10" cy="10" r="2.2" fill="{border}"/><circle cx="118" cy="10" r="2.2" fill="{border}"/>
<circle cx="10" cy="118" r="2.2" fill="{border}"/><circle cx="118" cy="118" r="2.2" fill="{border}"/>'''

def base(r):
    return f'''
<rect x="2" y="2" width="124" height="124" rx="14" fill="url(#bg)"/>
<rect x="2" y="2" width="124" height="124" rx="14" fill="url(#beam)"/>'''

def halo(cx, cy, rx):
    return f'<ellipse cx="{cx}" cy="{cy}" rx="{rx}" ry="{rx}" fill="url(#halo)"/>'

def ground(cx, cy, rx, op=0.4):
    return f'<ellipse cx="{cx}" cy="{cy}" rx="{rx}" ry="{rx*0.28:.0f}" fill="#000000" opacity="{op}"/>'

def spec(cx, cy, rx, ry, op=0.75, color="#ffffff"):
    return f'<ellipse cx="{cx}" cy="{cy}" rx="{rx}" ry="{ry}" fill="{color}" opacity="{op}"/>'

def finish(r, body):
    return header(r) + base(r) + body + '\n<rect x="2" y="2" width="124" height="124" rx="14" fill="url(#vig)"/>' + frame(r) + '\n</svg>'

    return inner + f'\n{spec(cx, cy, 8, 5, 0.65)}'

// 按单位分组，每组一次性优先；不同单位不相加。
function resolveMarketingQuota(data, locale) {
  if (!data.zcode_plan || typeof data.zcode_plan !== 'object') return null;
  const all = Array.isArray(data.zcode_plan.entitlements) ? data.zcode_plan.entitlements : [];
  const zh = locale.startsWith('zh');
  const compact = new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, { notation: 'compact', maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
  const normalize = value => {
    if (typeof value !== 'string' || !value.trim()) return 'tokens';
    const unit = value.trim();
    if (['token', 'tokens'].includes(unit.toLowerCase())) return 'tokens';
    if (['credit', 'credits'].includes(unit.toLowerCase())) return 'credits';
    return unit;
  };
  const label = (unit, daily) => `${unit === 'credits' && zh ? '积分' : unit}${daily ? (zh ? ' / 天' : ' / day') : ''}`;
  const byUnit = new Map();
  for (const e of all) {
    if (!e || e.meter !== 'model_usage' || typeof e.grant_units !== 'number' ||
        !Number.isFinite(e.grant_units) || e.grant_units < 0 || !['one_time', 'daily'].includes(e.period)) continue;
    const unit = normalize(e.unit_type);
    if (!byUnit.has(unit)) byUnit.set(unit, []);
    byUnit.get(unit).push(e);
  }
  const groups = [...byUnit].map(([unit, values]) => {
    const once = values.filter(e => e.period === 'one_time');
    const entries = once.length ? once : values.filter(e => e.period === 'daily');
    const daily = !once.length;
    return { entries, total: entries.reduce((sum, e) => sum + e.grant_units, 0), unit: label(unit, daily) };
  });
  const mixed = groups.length > 1;
  return {
    amountValue: mixed ? groups.map(g => `${compact.format(g.total)} ${g.unit}`).join(' + ') : new Intl.NumberFormat(locale).format(groups[0]?.total ?? 0),
    amountUnit: mixed ? '' : groups[0]?.unit ?? 'tokens',
    mixed,
    entries: groups.flatMap(g => g.entries),
    benefits: groups.flatMap(g => g.entries.map(e => `${typeof e.show_name === 'string' ? e.show_name : ''} · ${compact.format(e.grant_units)} ${g.unit}`)),
  };
}

      <svg

// Hero 与 Banner 共用：一次性优先，同周期叠加；未知周期不混入合计。
function resolveMarketingQuota(data, locale) {
  if (!data.zcode_plan || typeof data.zcode_plan !== 'object') return null;
  const all = Array.isArray(data.zcode_plan.entitlements) ? data.zcode_plan.entitlements : [];
  const eligible = all.filter(e => e && e.meter === 'model_usage' &&
    typeof e.grant_units === 'number' && Number.isFinite(e.grant_units) && e.grant_units >= 0 &&
    ['one_time', 'daily'].includes(e.period));
  const once = eligible.filter(e => e.period === 'one_time');
  const entries = once.length ? once : eligible.filter(e => e.period === 'daily');
  const daily = !once.length && entries.length > 0;
  const total = entries.reduce((sum, e) => sum + e.grant_units, 0);
  return {
    amountValue: new Intl.NumberFormat(locale).format(total),
    amountUnit: daily ? (locale.startsWith('zh') ? 'Tokens / 天' : 'Tokens / day') : 'Tokens',
    entries,
    benefits: entries.map(e => `${typeof e.show_name === 'string' ? e.show_name : ''} · ${new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, { notation: 'compact', maximumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(e.grant_units)} ${daily ? (locale.startsWith('zh') ? 'Tokens / 天' : 'Tokens / day') : 'Tokens'}`),
  };
}
    </script>
    <script>
      (() => {
        "use strict";

        const CHANNEL = "zcode-cloud-hero-v1";
        const ENTER_DURATION = 900;
        const CORNERS = [
          [-0.88, -0.88],
          [0.88, -0.88],
          [0.88, 0.88],
          [-0.88, 0.88],
        ];
        const ticket = document.getElementById("ticket");
        const ticketFlip = document.getElementById("ticket-flip");
        const replay = document.getElementById("replay");
        let instanceId = "";
        let reducedMotion = false;
        let hovered = false;
        let pressed = false;
        let animationFrame = 0;
        let idleStartsAt = performance.now() + ENTER_DURATION;

        function seededRandomFactory() {
          let seed = 0x5a17c9e3;
          return () => {
            seed = (seed * 1664525 + 1013904223) >>> 0;
            return seed / 0x100000000;
          };
        }

        function createStars() {
          const stars = document.getElementById("stars");
          const random = seededRandomFactory();
          for (let index = 0; index < 48; index += 1) {
            const star = document.createElement("span");
            const size = 0.5 + random() * 1.25;
            const cool = random() > 0.58;
            star.className = "star";
            Object.assign(star.style, {
              left: `${random() * 100}%`,
              top: `${random() * 100}%`,
              width: `${size}px`,
              height: `${size}px`,
              opacity: String(0.18 + random() * 0.62),
              backgroundColor: cool ? "rgb(125 211 252)" : "white",
            });
            stars.append(star);
          }

          const rays = document.getElementById("rays");
          for (let index = 0; index < 28; index += 1) {
            const ray = document.createElement("span");
            ray.className = "ray";
            ray.style.width = `${8 + ((index * 7) % 18)}px`;
            ray.style.transform = `rotate(${(index * 137.5 + 11) % 360}deg)`;
            ray.style.setProperty("--delay", `${-((index * 0.37) % 3.6)}s`);
            ray.style.setProperty("--duration", `${2.1 + ((index * 17) % 13) / 10}s`);
            rays.append(ray);
          }
        }

        function setText(id, value) {
          document.getElementById(id).textContent = typeof value === "string" ? value : "";
        }

        function renderData(data) {
          const quota = resolveMarketingQuota(data, document.documentElement.lang || "en-US");
          if (quota) data = { ...data, ...quota };
          setText("plan-name", data.planName);
          setText("amount-value", data.amountValue || data.amountLabel);
          setText("amount-unit", data.amountUnit);
          setText("expiry-prefix", data.endsAtPrefix);
          setText("expiry-value", data.endsAtLabel || "—");
          replay.setAttribute("aria-label", data.replayLabel || "Replay");
          const benefits = document.getElementById("benefits");
          benefits.replaceChildren();
          const values = Array.isArray(data.benefits) ? data.benefits : [];
          values.forEach((value) => {
            if (typeof value !== "string") return;
            const row = document.createElement("div");
            row.className = "benefit";
            // 原字符占位不等同于权益图标；只克隆包内固定 SVG，不解析远端 HTML。
            const icon = document
              .getElementById("benefit-icon-template")
              .content.firstElementChild.cloneNode(true);
            const text = document.createElement("span");
            text.className = "benefit-text";
            text.textContent = value;
            row.append(icon, text);
            benefits.append(row);
          });
        }

        function setPressure(x, y, down) {
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-transition-duration", "140ms");
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-rx", `${-y * 4}deg`);
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-ry", `${x * 5}deg`);
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-x", `${((x + 1) / 2) * 100}%`);
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-y", `${((y + 1) / 2) * 100}%`);
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-depth", down ? "-12px" : "-5px");
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-scale", down ? "0.98" : "0.995");
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-shadow-x", `${-x * 8}px`);
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-shadow-y", `${18 - y * 3}px`);
        }

        function resetPressure() {
          hovered = false;
          pressed = false;
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-rx", "0deg");
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-ry", "0deg");
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-x", "50%");
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-y", "50%");
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-depth", "0px");
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-scale", "1");
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-shadow-x", "0px");
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-shadow-y", "18px");
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-transition-duration", "280ms");
        }

        function replayHero(emitAction = true) {
          ticketFlip.getAnimations().forEach((animation) => animation.cancel());
          resetPressure();
          idleStartsAt = performance.now() + ENTER_DURATION;
          ticket.dataset.idlePressure = "waiting-for-entry";
          ticketFlip.classList.remove("is-entering");
          void ticketFlip.offsetWidth;
          if (!reducedMotion) ticketFlip.classList.add("is-entering");
          const galaxy = document.querySelector(".galaxy");
          galaxy.style.animation = "none";
          void galaxy.offsetWidth;
          galaxy.style.animation = "";
          if (instanceId && emitAction) {
            parent.postMessage({ channel: CHANNEL, type: "action", instanceId, id: "replay" }, "*");
          }
        }

        function animateIdle(now) {
          animationFrame = 0;
          if (!reducedMotion && now >= idleStartsAt && !hovered) {
            ticket.dataset.idlePressure = "active";
            const raw = ((now - idleStartsAt) / 5200) * CORNERS.length;
            const progress = ((raw % CORNERS.length) + CORNERS.length) % CORNERS.length;
            const index = Math.floor(progress);
            const next = (index + 1) % CORNERS.length;
            const rawOffset = progress - index;
            const offset = rawOffset * rawOffset * (3 - 2 * rawOffset);
            const x = CORNERS[index][0] + (CORNERS[next][0] - CORNERS[index][0]) * offset;
            const y = CORNERS[index][1] + (CORNERS[next][1] - CORNERS[index][1]) * offset;
            ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-transition-duration", "80ms");
            ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-rx", `${-y * 8}deg`);
            ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-ry", `${x * 10}deg`);
            ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-x", `${((x + 1) / 2) * 100}%`);
            ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-y", `${((y + 1) / 2) * 100}%`);
            ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-depth", `${-10 - Math.abs(x * y) * 2}px`);
            ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-scale", "0.975");
            ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-shadow-x", `${-x * 22}px`);
            ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-shadow-y", `${20 - y * 11}px`);
          }
          scheduleIdle();
        }

        function scheduleIdle() {
          if (
            !animationFrame &&
            instanceId &&
            !reducedMotion &&
            document.documentElement.dataset.visible !== "false" &&
            !document.hidden
          ) {
            animationFrame = requestAnimationFrame(animateIdle);
          }
        }

        function updateVisibility() {
          cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrame);
          animationFrame = 0;
          const visible = document.documentElement.dataset.visible !== "false" && !document.hidden;
          ticketFlip.getAnimations().forEach((animation) => {
            if (!visible) animation.pause();
            else if (animation.playState === "paused") animation.play();
          });
          scheduleIdle();
        }

        ticketFlip.addEventListener("animationend", (event) => {
          if (event.target === ticketFlip && event.animationName === "ticket-enter") {
            ticketFlip.classList.remove("is-entering");
          }
        });
        document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", updateVisibility);

        ticket.addEventListener("pointerenter", () => {
          hovered = true;
        });
        ticket.addEventListener("pointermove", (event) => {
          if (reducedMotion) return;
          const bounds = ticket.getBoundingClientRect();
          if (!bounds.width || !bounds.height) return;
          const x = Math.max(
            -1,
            Math.min(1, ((event.clientX - bounds.left) / bounds.width) * 2 - 1),
          );
          const y = Math.max(
            -1,
            Math.min(1, ((event.clientY - bounds.top) / bounds.height) * 2 - 1),
          );
          setPressure(x, y, pressed);
        });
        ticket.addEventListener("pointerdown", () => {
          if (reducedMotion) return;
          pressed = true;
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-depth", "-12px");
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-scale", "0.98");
        });
        ticket.addEventListener("pointerup", () => {
          if (reducedMotion) return;
          pressed = false;
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-depth", "-5px");
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-scale", "0.995");
        });
        ticket.addEventListener("pointerleave", resetPressure);
        ticket.addEventListener("pointercancel", resetPressure);
        ticket.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
          if (reducedMotion || typeof ticketFlip.animate !== "function") return;
          ticketFlip.getAnimations().forEach((animation) => animation.cancel());
          // 入场被点击打断不会触发 animationend，也必须恢复原生背面。
          ticketFlip.classList.remove("is-entering");
          const bounds = ticket.getBoundingClientRect();
          const direction = event.clientX < bounds.left + bounds.width / 2 ? -1 : 1;
          ticketFlip.animate(
            [{ transform: "rotateY(0deg)" }, { transform: `rotateY(${direction * 360}deg)` }],
            { duration: 720, easing: "cubic-bezier(0.22, 0.72, 0.18, 1)" },
          );
        });
        replay.addEventListener("click", () => replayHero());

        window.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
          if (event.source !== parent) return;
          const message = event.data;
          if (!message || message.channel !== CHANNEL || typeof message.instanceId !== "string") {
            return;
          }
          if (message.type === "init") {
            instanceId = message.instanceId;
            document.documentElement.dataset.theme = message.theme === "dark" ? "dark" : "light";
            document.documentElement.lang =
              typeof message.locale === "string" ? message.locale : "en";
            reducedMotion = message.reducedMotion === true;
            document.documentElement.dataset.reducedMotion = String(reducedMotion);
            renderData(message.data || {});
            replayHero(false);
            updateVisibility();
            parent.postMessage({ channel: CHANNEL, type: "ready", instanceId }, "*");
            return;
          }
          if (!instanceId || message.instanceId !== instanceId) return;
          if (message.type === "theme") {
            document.documentElement.dataset.theme = message.theme === "dark" ? "dark" : "light";
          } else if (message.type === "visibility") {
            document.documentElement.dataset.visible = String(message.visible);
            updateVisibility();
          } else if (message.type === "destroy") {
            cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrame);
            animationFrame = 0;
            document.documentElement.dataset.visible = "false";
            ticketFlip.getAnimations().forEach((animation) => animation.cancel());
            ticketFlip.classList.remove("is-entering");
            instanceId = "";
          }
        });

        createStars();
      })();
    </script>
  </body>
</html>

// 按单位分组，每组一次性优先；不同单位不相加。
function resolveMarketingQuota(data, locale) {
  if (!data.zcode_plan || typeof data.zcode_plan !== 'object') return null;
  const all = Array.isArray(data.zcode_plan.entitlements) ? data.zcode_plan.entitlements : [];
  const zh = locale.startsWith('zh');
  const compact = new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, { notation: 'compact', maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
  const normalize = value => {
    if (typeof value !== 'string' || !value.trim()) return 'tokens';
    const unit = value.trim();
    if (['token', 'tokens'].includes(unit.toLowerCase())) return 'tokens';
    if (['credit', 'credits'].includes(unit.toLowerCase())) return 'credits';
    return unit;
  };
  const label = (unit, daily) => `${unit === 'credits' && zh ? '积分' : unit}${daily ? (zh ? ' / 天' : ' / day') : ''}`;
  const byUnit = new Map();
  for (const e of all) {
    if (!e || e.meter !== 'model_usage' || typeof e.grant_units !== 'number' ||
        !Number.isFinite(e.grant_units) || e.grant_units < 0 || !['one_time', 'daily'].includes(e.period)) continue;
    const unit = normalize(e.unit_type);
    if (!byUnit.has(unit)) byUnit.set(unit, []);
    byUnit.get(unit).push(e);
  }
  const groups = [...byUnit].map(([unit, values]) => {
    const once = values.filter(e => e.period === 'one_time');
    const entries = once.length ? once : values.filter(e => e.period === 'daily');
    const daily = !once.length;
    return { entries, total: entries.reduce((sum, e) => sum + e.grant_units, 0), unit: label(unit, daily) };
  });
  const mixed = groups.length > 1;
  return {
    amountValue: mixed ? groups.map(g => `${compact.format(g.total)} ${g.unit}`).join(' + ') : new Intl.NumberFormat(locale).format(groups[0]?.total ?? 0),
    amountUnit: mixed ? '' : groups[0]?.unit ?? 'tokens',
    mixed,
    entries: groups.flatMap(g => g.entries),
    benefits: groups.flatMap(g => g.entries.map(e => `${typeof e.show_name === 'string' ? e.show_name : ''} · ${compact.format(e.grant_units)} ${g.unit}`)),
  };
}

// Hero 与 Banner 共用：一次性优先，同周期叠加；未知周期不混入合计。
function resolveMarketingQuota(data, locale) {
  if (!data.zcode_plan || typeof data.zcode_plan !== 'object') return null;
  const all = Array.isArray(data.zcode_plan.entitlements) ? data.zcode_plan.entitlements : [];
  const eligible = all.filter(e => e && e.meter === 'model_usage' &&
    typeof e.grant_units === 'number' && Number.isFinite(e.grant_units) && e.grant_units >= 0 &&
    ['one_time', 'daily'].includes(e.period));
  const once = eligible.filter(e => e.period === 'one_time');
  const entries = once.length ? once : eligible.filter(e => e.period === 'daily');
  const daily = !once.length && entries.length > 0;
  const total = entries.reduce((sum, e) => sum + e.grant_units, 0);
  return {
    amountValue: new Intl.NumberFormat(locale).format(total),
    amountUnit: daily ? (locale.startsWith('zh') ? 'Tokens / 天' : 'Tokens / day') : 'Tokens',
    entries,
    benefits: entries.map(e => `${typeof e.show_name === 'string' ? e.show_name : ''} · ${new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, { notation: 'compact', maximumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(e.grant_units)} ${daily ? (locale.startsWith('zh') ? 'Tokens / 天' : 'Tokens / day') : 'Tokens'}`),
  };
}

    <script>
      (() => {
        "use strict";

        const CHANNEL = "zcode-cloud-hero-v1";
        const ENTER_DURATION = 900;
        const CORNERS = [
          [-0.88, -0.88],
          [0.88, -0.88],
          [0.88, 0.88],
          [-0.88, 0.88],
        ];
        const ticket = document.getElementById("ticket");
        const ticketFlip = document.getElementById("ticket-flip");
        const replay = document.getElementById("replay");
        let instanceId = "";
        let reducedMotion = false;
        let hovered = false;
        let pressed = false;
        let animationFrame = 0;
        let idleStartsAt = performance.now() + ENTER_DURATION;

        function seededRandomFactory() {
          let seed = 0x5a17c9e3;
          return () => {
            seed = (seed * 1664525 + 1013904223) >>> 0;
            return seed / 0x100000000;
          };
        }

        function createStars() {
          const stars = document.getElementById("stars");
          const random = seededRandomFactory();
          for (let index = 0; index < 48; index += 1) {
            const star = document.createElement("span");
            const size = 0.5 + random() * 1.25;
            const cool = random() > 0.58;
            star.className = "star";
            Object.assign(star.style, {
              left: `${random() * 100}%`,
              top: `${random() * 100}%`,
              width: `${size}px`,
              height: `${size}px`,
              opacity: String(0.18 + random() * 0.62),
              backgroundColor: cool ? "rgb(125 211 252)" : "white",
            });
            stars.append(star);
          }

          const rays = document.getElementById("rays");
          for (let index = 0; index < 28; index += 1) {
            const ray = document.createElement("span");
            ray.className = "ray";
            ray.style.width = `${8 + ((index * 7) % 18)}px`;
            ray.style.transform = `rotate(${(index * 137.5 + 11) % 360}deg)`;
            ray.style.setProperty("--delay", `${-((index * 0.37) % 3.6)}s`);
            ray.style.setProperty("--duration", `${2.1 + ((index * 17) % 13) / 10}s`);
            rays.append(ray);
          }
        }

        function setText(id, value) {
          document.getElementById(id).textContent = typeof value === "string" ? value : "";
        }

        function renderData(data) {
          const quota = resolveMarketingQuota(data, document.documentElement.lang || "en-US");
          if (quota) data = { ...data, ...quota };
          setText("plan-name", data.planName);
          setText("amount-value", data.amountValue || data.amountLabel);
          setText("amount-unit", data.amountUnit);
          setText("expiry-prefix", data.endsAtPrefix);
          setText("expiry-value", data.endsAtLabel || "—");
          replay.setAttribute("aria-label", data.replayLabel || "Replay");
          const benefits = document.getElementById("benefits");
          benefits.replaceChildren();
          const values = Array.isArray(data.benefits) ? data.benefits : [];
          values.forEach((value) => {
            if (typeof value !== "string") return;
            const row = document.createElement("div");
            row.className = "benefit";
            // 原字符占位不等同于权益图标；只克隆包内固定 SVG，不解析远端 HTML。
            const icon = document
              .getElementById("benefit-icon-template")
              .content.firstElementChild.cloneNode(true);
            const text = document.createElement("span");
            text.className = "benefit-text";
            text.textContent = value;
            row.append(icon, text);
            benefits.append(row);
          });
        }

        function setPressure(x, y, down) {
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-transition-duration", "140ms");
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-rx", `${-y * 4}deg`);
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-ry", `${x * 5}deg`);
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-x", `${((x + 1) / 2) * 100}%`);
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-y", `${((y + 1) / 2) * 100}%`);
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-depth", down ? "-12px" : "-5px");
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-scale", down ? "0.98" : "0.995");
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-shadow-x", `${-x * 8}px`);
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-shadow-y", `${18 - y * 3}px`);
        }

        function resetPressure() {
          hovered = false;
          pressed = false;
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-rx", "0deg");
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-ry", "0deg");
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-x", "50%");
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-y", "50%");
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-depth", "0px");
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-scale", "1");
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-shadow-x", "0px");
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-shadow-y", "18px");
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-transition-duration", "280ms");
        }

        function replayHero(emitAction = true) {
          ticketFlip.getAnimations().forEach((animation) => animation.cancel());
          resetPressure();
          idleStartsAt = performance.now() + ENTER_DURATION;
          ticket.dataset.idlePressure = "waiting-for-entry";
          ticketFlip.classList.remove("is-entering");
          void ticketFlip.offsetWidth;
          if (!reducedMotion) ticketFlip.classList.add("is-entering");
          const galaxy = document.querySelector(".galaxy");
          galaxy.style.animation = "none";
          void galaxy.offsetWidth;
          galaxy.style.animation = "";
          if (instanceId && emitAction) {
            parent.postMessage({ channel: CHANNEL, type: "action", instanceId, id: "replay" }, "*");
          }
        }

        function animateIdle(now) {
          animationFrame = 0;
          if (!reducedMotion && now >= idleStartsAt && !hovered) {
            ticket.dataset.idlePressure = "active";
            const raw = ((now - idleStartsAt) / 5200) * CORNERS.length;
            const progress = ((raw % CORNERS.length) + CORNERS.length) % CORNERS.length;
            const index = Math.floor(progress);
            const next = (index + 1) % CORNERS.length;
            const rawOffset = progress - index;
            const offset = rawOffset * rawOffset * (3 - 2 * rawOffset);
            const x = CORNERS[index][0] + (CORNERS[next][0] - CORNERS[index][0]) * offset;
            const y = CORNERS[index][1] + (CORNERS[next][1] - CORNERS[index][1]) * offset;
            ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-transition-duration", "80ms");
            ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-rx", `${-y * 8}deg`);
            ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-ry", `${x * 10}deg`);
            ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-x", `${((x + 1) / 2) * 100}%`);
            ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-y", `${((y + 1) / 2) * 100}%`);
            ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-depth", `${-10 - Math.abs(x * y) * 2}px`);
            ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-scale", "0.975");
            ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-shadow-x", `${-x * 22}px`);
            ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-shadow-y", `${20 - y * 11}px`);
          }
          scheduleIdle();
        }

        function scheduleIdle() {
          if (
            !animationFrame &&
            instanceId &&
            !reducedMotion &&
            document.documentElement.dataset.visible !== "false" &&
            !document.hidden
          ) {
            animationFrame = requestAnimationFrame(animateIdle);
          }
        }

        function updateVisibility() {
          cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrame);
          animationFrame = 0;
          const visible = document.documentElement.dataset.visible !== "false" && !document.hidden;
          ticketFlip.getAnimations().forEach((animation) => {
            if (!visible) animation.pause();
            else if (animation.playState === "paused") animation.play();
          });
          scheduleIdle();
        }

        ticketFlip.addEventListener("animationend", (event) => {
          if (event.target === ticketFlip && event.animationName === "ticket-enter") {
            ticketFlip.classList.remove("is-entering");
          }
        });
        document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", updateVisibility);

        ticket.addEventListener("pointerenter", () => {
          hovered = true;
        });
        ticket.addEventListener("pointermove", (event) => {
          if (reducedMotion) return;
          const bounds = ticket.getBoundingClientRect();
          if (!bounds.width || !bounds.height) return;
          const x = Math.max(
            -1,
            Math.min(1, ((event.clientX - bounds.left) / bounds.width) * 2 - 1),
          );
          const y = Math.max(
            -1,
            Math.min(1, ((event.clientY - bounds.top) / bounds.height) * 2 - 1),
          );
          setPressure(x, y, pressed);
        });
        ticket.addEventListener("pointerdown", () => {
          if (reducedMotion) return;
          pressed = true;
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-depth", "-12px");
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-scale", "0.98");
        });
        ticket.addEventListener("pointerup", () => {
          if (reducedMotion) return;
          pressed = false;
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-depth", "-5px");
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-scale", "0.995");
        });
        ticket.addEventListener("pointerleave", resetPressure);
        ticket.addEventListener("pointercancel", resetPressure);
        ticket.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
          if (reducedMotion || typeof ticketFlip.animate !== "function") return;
          ticketFlip.getAnimations().forEach((animation) => animation.cancel());
          // 入场被点击打断不会触发 animationend，也必须恢复原生背面。
          ticketFlip.classList.remove("is-entering");
          const bounds = ticket.getBoundingClientRect();
          const direction = event.clientX < bounds.left + bounds.width / 2 ? -1 : 1;
          ticketFlip.animate(
            [{ transform: "rotateY(0deg)" }, { transform: `rotateY(${direction * 360}deg)` }],
            { duration: 720, easing: "cubic-bezier(0.22, 0.72, 0.18, 1)" },
          );
        });
        replay.addEventListener("click", () => replayHero());

        window.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
          if (event.source !== parent) return;
          const message = event.data;
          if (!message || message.channel !== CHANNEL || typeof message.instanceId !== "string") {
            return;
          }
          if (message.type === "init") {
            instanceId = message.instanceId;
            document.documentElement.dataset.theme = message.theme === "dark" ? "dark" : "light";
            document.documentElement.lang =
              typeof message.locale === "string" ? message.locale : "en";
            reducedMotion = message.reducedMotion === true;
            document.documentElement.dataset.reducedMotion = String(reducedMotion);
            renderData(message.data || {});
            replayHero(false);
            updateVisibility();
            parent.postMessage({ channel: CHANNEL, type: "ready", instanceId }, "*");
            return;
          }
          if (!instanceId || message.instanceId !== instanceId) return;
          if (message.type === "theme") {
            document.documentElement.dataset.theme = message.theme === "dark" ? "dark" : "light";
          } else if (message.type === "visibility") {
            document.documentElement.dataset.visible = String(message.visible);
            updateVisibility();
          } else if (message.type === "destroy") {
            cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrame);
            animationFrame = 0;
            document.documentElement.dataset.visible = "false";
            ticketFlip.getAnimations().forEach((animation) => animation.cancel());
            ticketFlip.classList.remove("is-entering");
            instanceId = "";
          }
        });

        createStars();
      })();
    </script>
  </body>
</html>

// 按单位分组，每组一次性优先；不同单位不相加。
function resolveMarketingQuota(data, locale) {
  if (!data.zcode_plan || typeof data.zcode_plan !== 'object') return null;
  const all = Array.isArray(data.zcode_plan.entitlements) ? data.zcode_plan.entitlements : [];
  const zh = locale.startsWith('zh');
  const compact = new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, { notation: 'compact', maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
  const normalize = value => {
    if (typeof value !== 'string' || !value.trim()) return 'tokens';
    const unit = value.trim();
    if (['token', 'tokens'].includes(unit.toLowerCase())) return 'tokens';
    if (['credit', 'credits'].includes(unit.toLowerCase())) return 'credits';
    return unit;
  };
  const label = (unit, daily) => `${unit === 'credits' && zh ? '积分' : unit}${daily ? (zh ? ' / 天' : ' / day') : ''}`;
  const byUnit = new Map();
  for (const e of all) {
    if (!e || e.meter !== 'model_usage' || typeof e.grant_units !== 'number' ||
        !Number.isFinite(e.grant_units) || e.grant_units < 0 || !['one_time', 'daily'].includes(e.period)) continue;
    const unit = normalize(e.unit_type);
    if (!byUnit.has(unit)) byUnit.set(unit, []);
    byUnit.get(unit).push(e);
  }
  const groups = [...byUnit].map(([unit, values]) => {
    const once = values.filter(e => e.period === 'one_time');
    const entries = once.length ? once : values.filter(e => e.period === 'daily');
    const daily = !once.length;
    return { entries, total: entries.reduce((sum, e) => sum + e.grant_units, 0), unit: label(unit, daily) };
  });
  const mixed = groups.length > 1;
  return {
    amountValue: mixed ? groups.map(g => `${compact.format(g.total)} ${g.unit}`).join(' + ') : new Intl.NumberFormat(locale).format(groups[0]?.total ?? 0),
    amountUnit: mixed ? '' : groups[0]?.unit ?? 'tokens',
    mixed,
    entries: groups.flatMap(g => g.entries),
    benefits: groups.flatMap(g => g.entries.map(e => `${typeof e.show_name === 'string' ? e.show_name : ''} · ${compact.format(e.grant_units)} ${g.unit}`)),
  };
}

// Hero 与 Banner 共用：一次性优先，同周期叠加；未知周期不混入合计。
function resolveMarketingQuota(data, locale) {
  if (!data.zcode_plan || typeof data.zcode_plan !== 'object') return null;
  const all = Array.isArray(data.zcode_plan.entitlements) ? data.zcode_plan.entitlements : [];
  const eligible = all.filter(e => e && e.meter === 'model_usage' &&
    typeof e.grant_units === 'number' && Number.isFinite(e.grant_units) && e.grant_units >= 0 &&
    ['one_time', 'daily'].includes(e.period));
  const once = eligible.filter(e => e.period === 'one_time');
  const entries = once.length ? once : eligible.filter(e => e.period === 'daily');
  const daily = !once.length && entries.length > 0;
  const total = entries.reduce((sum, e) => sum + e.grant_units, 0);
  return {
    amountValue: new Intl.NumberFormat(locale).format(total),
    amountUnit: daily ? (locale.startsWith('zh') ? 'Tokens / 天' : 'Tokens / day') : 'Tokens',
    entries,
    benefits: entries.map(e => `${typeof e.show_name === 'string' ? e.show_name : ''} · ${new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, { notation: 'compact', maximumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(e.grant_units)} ${daily ? (locale.startsWith('zh') ? 'Tokens / 天' : 'Tokens / day') : 'Tokens'}`),
  };
}

    <script>
      (() => {
        "use strict";

        const CHANNEL = "zcode-cloud-hero-v1";
        const ENTER_DURATION = 900;
        const CORNERS = [
          [-0.88, -0.88],
          [0.88, -0.88],
          [0.88, 0.88],
          [-0.88, 0.88],
        ];
        const ticket = document.getElementById("ticket");
        const ticketFlip = document.getElementById("ticket-flip");
        const replay = document.getElementById("replay");
        let instanceId = "";
        let reducedMotion = false;
        let hovered = false;
        let pressed = false;
        let animationFrame = 0;
        let idleStartsAt = performance.now() + ENTER_DURATION;

        function seededRandomFactory() {
          let seed = 0x5a17c9e3;
          return () => {
            seed = (seed * 1664525 + 1013904223) >>> 0;
            return seed / 0x100000000;
          };
        }

        function createStars() {
          const stars = document.getElementById("stars");
          const random = seededRandomFactory();
          for (let index = 0; index < 48; index += 1) {
            const star = document.createElement("span");
            const size = 0.5 + random() * 1.25;
            const cool = random() > 0.58;
            star.className = "star";
            Object.assign(star.style, {
              left: `${random() * 100}%`,
              top: `${random() * 100}%`,
              width: `${size}px`,
              height: `${size}px`,
              opacity: String(0.18 + random() * 0.62),
              backgroundColor: cool ? "rgb(125 211 252)" : "white",
            });
            stars.append(star);
          }

          const rays = document.getElementById("rays");
          for (let index = 0; index < 28; index += 1) {
            const ray = document.createElement("span");
            ray.className = "ray";
            ray.style.width = `${8 + ((index * 7) % 18)}px`;
            ray.style.transform = `rotate(${(index * 137.5 + 11) % 360}deg)`;
            ray.style.setProperty("--delay", `${-((index * 0.37) % 3.6)}s`);
            ray.style.setProperty("--duration", `${2.1 + ((index * 17) % 13) / 10}s`);
            rays.append(ray);
          }
        }

        function setText(id, value) {
          document.getElementById(id).textContent = typeof value === "string" ? value : "";
        }

        function renderData(data) {
          const quota = resolveMarketingQuota(data, document.documentElement.lang || "en-US");
          if (quota) data = { ...data, ...quota };
          setText("plan-name", data.planName);
          setText("amount-value", data.amountValue || data.amountLabel);
          setText("amount-unit", data.amountUnit);
          setText("expiry-prefix", data.endsAtPrefix);
          setText("expiry-value", data.endsAtLabel || "—");
          replay.setAttribute("aria-label", data.replayLabel || "Replay");
          const benefits = document.getElementById("benefits");
          benefits.replaceChildren();
          const values = Array.isArray(data.benefits) ? data.benefits : [];
          values.forEach((value) => {
            if (typeof value !== "string") return;
            const row = document.createElement("div");
            row.className = "benefit";
            // 原字符占位不等同于权益图标；只克隆包内固定 SVG，不解析远端 HTML。
            const icon = document
              .getElementById("benefit-icon-template")
              .content.firstElementChild.cloneNode(true);
            const text = document.createElement("span");
            text.className = "benefit-text";
            text.textContent = value;
            row.append(icon, text);
            benefits.append(row);
          });
        }

        function setPressure(x, y, down) {
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-transition-duration", "140ms");
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-rx", `${-y * 4}deg`);
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-ry", `${x * 5}deg`);
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-x", `${((x + 1) / 2) * 100}%`);
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-y", `${((y + 1) / 2) * 100}%`);
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-depth", down ? "-12px" : "-5px");
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-scale", down ? "0.98" : "0.995");
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-shadow-x", `${-x * 8}px`);
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-shadow-y", `${18 - y * 3}px`);
        }

        function resetPressure() {
          hovered = false;
          pressed = false;
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-rx", "0deg");
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-ry", "0deg");
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-x", "50%");
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-y", "50%");
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-depth", "0px");
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-scale", "1");
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-shadow-x", "0px");
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-shadow-y", "18px");
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-transition-duration", "280ms");
        }

        function replayHero(emitAction = true) {
          ticketFlip.getAnimations().forEach((animation) => animation.cancel());
          resetPressure();
          idleStartsAt = performance.now() + ENTER_DURATION;
          ticket.dataset.idlePressure = "waiting-for-entry";
          ticketFlip.classList.remove("is-entering");
          void ticketFlip.offsetWidth;
          if (!reducedMotion) ticketFlip.classList.add("is-entering");
          const galaxy = document.querySelector(".galaxy");
          galaxy.style.animation = "none";
          void galaxy.offsetWidth;
          galaxy.style.animation = "";
          if (instanceId && emitAction) {
            parent.postMessage({ channel: CHANNEL, type: "action", instanceId, id: "replay" }, "*");
          }
        }

        function animateIdle(now) {
          animationFrame = 0;
          if (!reducedMotion && now >= idleStartsAt && !hovered) {
            ticket.dataset.idlePressure = "active";
            const raw = ((now - idleStartsAt) / 5200) * CORNERS.length;
            const progress = ((raw % CORNERS.length) + CORNERS.length) % CORNERS.length;
            const index = Math.floor(progress);
            const next = (index + 1) % CORNERS.length;
            const rawOffset = progress - index;
            const offset = rawOffset * rawOffset * (3 - 2 * rawOffset);
            const x = CORNERS[index][0] + (CORNERS[next][0] - CORNERS[index][0]) * offset;
            const y = CORNERS[index][1] + (CORNERS[next][1] - CORNERS[index][1]) * offset;
            ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-transition-duration", "80ms");
            ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-rx", `${-y * 8}deg`);
            ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-ry", `${x * 10}deg`);
            ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-x", `${((x + 1) / 2) * 100}%`);
            ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-y", `${((y + 1) / 2) * 100}%`);
            ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-depth", `${-10 - Math.abs(x * y) * 2}px`);
            ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-scale", "0.975");
            ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-shadow-x", `${-x * 22}px`);
            ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-shadow-y", `${20 - y * 11}px`);
          }
          scheduleIdle();
        }

        function scheduleIdle() {
          if (
            !animationFrame &&
            instanceId &&
            !reducedMotion &&
            document.documentElement.dataset.visible !== "false" &&
            !document.hidden
          ) {
            animationFrame = requestAnimationFrame(animateIdle);
          }
        }

        function updateVisibility() {
          cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrame);
          animationFrame = 0;
          const visible = document.documentElement.dataset.visible !== "false" && !document.hidden;
          ticketFlip.getAnimations().forEach((animation) => {
            if (!visible) animation.pause();
            else if (animation.playState === "paused") animation.play();
          });
          scheduleIdle();
        }

        ticketFlip.addEventListener("animationend", (event) => {
          if (event.target === ticketFlip && event.animationName === "ticket-enter") {
            ticketFlip.classList.remove("is-entering");
          }
        });
        document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", updateVisibility);

        ticket.addEventListener("pointerenter", () => {
          hovered = true;
        });
        ticket.addEventListener("pointermove", (event) => {
          if (reducedMotion) return;
          const bounds = ticket.getBoundingClientRect();
          if (!bounds.width || !bounds.height) return;
          const x = Math.max(
            -1,
            Math.min(1, ((event.clientX - bounds.left) / bounds.width) * 2 - 1),
          );
          const y = Math.max(
            -1,
            Math.min(1, ((event.clientY - bounds.top) / bounds.height) * 2 - 1),
          );
          setPressure(x, y, pressed);
        });
        ticket.addEventListener("pointerdown", () => {
          if (reducedMotion) return;
          pressed = true;
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-depth", "-12px");
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-scale", "0.98");
        });
        ticket.addEventListener("pointerup", () => {
          if (reducedMotion) return;
          pressed = false;
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-depth", "-5px");
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-scale", "0.995");
        });
        ticket.addEventListener("pointerleave", resetPressure);
        ticket.addEventListener("pointercancel", resetPressure);
        ticket.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
          if (reducedMotion || typeof ticketFlip.animate !== "function") return;
          ticketFlip.getAnimations().forEach((animation) => animation.cancel());
          // 入场被点击打断不会触发 animationend，也必须恢复原生背面。
          ticketFlip.classList.remove("is-entering");
          const bounds = ticket.getBoundingClientRect();
          const direction = event.clientX < bounds.left + bounds.width / 2 ? -1 : 1;
          ticketFlip.animate(
            [{ transform: "rotateY(0deg)" }, { transform: `rotateY(${direction * 360}deg)` }],
            { duration: 720, easing: "cubic-bezier(0.22, 0.72, 0.18, 1)" },
          );
        });
        replay.addEventListener("click", () => replayHero());

        window.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
          if (event.source !== parent) return;
          const message = event.data;
          if (!message || message.channel !== CHANNEL || typeof message.instanceId !== "string") {
            return;
          }
          if (message.type === "init") {
            instanceId = message.instanceId;
            document.documentElement.dataset.theme = message.theme === "dark" ? "dark" : "light";
            document.documentElement.lang =
              typeof message.locale === "string" ? message.locale : "en";
            reducedMotion = message.reducedMotion === true;
            document.documentElement.dataset.reducedMotion = String(reducedMotion);
            renderData(message.data || {});
            replayHero(false);
            updateVisibility();
            parent.postMessage({ channel: CHANNEL, type: "ready", instanceId }, "*");
            return;
          }
          if (!instanceId || message.instanceId !== instanceId) return;
          if (message.type === "theme") {
            document.documentElement.dataset.theme = message.theme === "dark" ? "dark" : "light";
          } else if (message.type === "visibility") {
            document.documentElement.dataset.visible = String(message.visible);
            updateVisibility();
          } else if (message.type === "destroy") {
            cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrame);
            animationFrame = 0;
            document.documentElement.dataset.visible = "false";
            ticketFlip.getAnimations().forEach((animation) => animation.cancel());
            ticketFlip.classList.remove("is-entering");
            instanceId = "";
          }
        });

        createStars();
      })();
    </script>
  </body>
</html>

// 按单位分组，每组一次性优先；不同单位不相加。
function resolveMarketingQuota(data, locale) {
  if (!data.zcode_plan || typeof data.zcode_plan !== 'object') return null;
  const all = Array.isArray(data.zcode_plan.entitlements) ? data.zcode_plan.entitlements : [];
  const zh = locale.startsWith('zh');
  const compact = new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, { notation: 'compact', maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
  const normalize = value => {
    if (typeof value !== 'string' || !value.trim()) return 'tokens';
    const unit = value.trim();
    if (['token', 'tokens'].includes(unit.toLowerCase())) return 'tokens';
    if (['credit', 'credits'].includes(unit.toLowerCase())) return 'credits';
    return unit;
  };
  const label = (unit, daily) => `${unit === 'credits' && zh ? '积分' : unit}${daily ? (zh ? ' / 天' : ' / day') : ''}`;
  const byUnit = new Map();
  for (const e of all) {
    if (!e || e.meter !== 'model_usage' || typeof e.grant_units !== 'number' ||
        !Number.isFinite(e.grant_units) || e.grant_units < 0 || !['one_time', 'daily'].includes(e.period)) continue;
    const unit = normalize(e.unit_type);
    if (!byUnit.has(unit)) byUnit.set(unit, []);
    byUnit.get(unit).push(e);
  }
  const groups = [...byUnit].map(([unit, values]) => {
    const once = values.filter(e => e.period === 'one_time');
    const entries = once.length ? once : values.filter(e => e.period === 'daily');
    const daily = !once.length;
    return { entries, total: entries.reduce((sum, e) => sum + e.grant_units, 0), unit: label(unit, daily) };
  });
  const mixed = groups.length > 1;
  return {
    amountValue: mixed ? groups.map(g => `${compact.format(g.total)} ${g.unit}`).join(' + ') : new Intl.NumberFormat(locale).format(groups[0]?.total ?? 0),
    amountUnit: mixed ? '' : groups[0]?.unit ?? 'tokens',
    mixed,
    entries: groups.flatMap(g => g.entries),
    benefits: groups.flatMap(g => g.entries.map(e => `${typeof e.show_name === 'string' ? e.show_name : ''} · ${compact.format(e.grant_units)} ${g.unit}`)),
  };
}

// Hero 与 Banner 共用：一次性优先，同周期叠加；未知周期不混入合计。
function resolveMarketingQuota(data, locale) {
  if (!data.zcode_plan || typeof data.zcode_plan !== 'object') return null;
  const all = Array.isArray(data.zcode_plan.entitlements) ? data.zcode_plan.entitlements : [];
  const eligible = all.filter(e => e && e.meter === 'model_usage' &&
    typeof e.grant_units === 'number' && Number.isFinite(e.grant_units) && e.grant_units >= 0 &&
    ['one_time', 'daily'].includes(e.period));
  const once = eligible.filter(e => e.period === 'one_time');
  const entries = once.length ? once : eligible.filter(e => e.period === 'daily');
  const daily = !once.length && entries.length > 0;
  const total = entries.reduce((sum, e) => sum + e.grant_units, 0);
  return {
    amountValue: new Intl.NumberFormat(locale).format(total),
    amountUnit: daily ? (locale.startsWith('zh') ? 'Tokens / 天' : 'Tokens / day') : 'Tokens',
    entries,
    benefits: entries.map(e => `${typeof e.show_name === 'string' ? e.show_name : ''} · ${new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, { notation: 'compact', maximumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(e.grant_units)} ${daily ? (locale.startsWith('zh') ? 'Tokens / 天' : 'Tokens / day') : 'Tokens'}`),
  };
}

    <script>
      (() => {
        "use strict";

        const CHANNEL = "zcode-cloud-hero-v1";
        const ENTER_DURATION = 900;
        const CORNERS = [
          [-0.88, -0.88],
          [0.88, -0.88],
          [0.88, 0.88],
          [-0.88, 0.88],
        ];
        const ticket = document.getElementById("ticket");
        const ticketFlip = document.getElementById("ticket-flip");
        const replay = document.getElementById("replay");
        let instanceId = "";
        let reducedMotion = false;
        let hovered = false;
        let pressed = false;
        let animationFrame = 0;
        let idleStartsAt = performance.now() + ENTER_DURATION;

        function seededRandomFactory() {
          let seed = 0x5a17c9e3;
          return () => {
            seed = (seed * 1664525 + 1013904223) >>> 0;
            return seed / 0x100000000;
          };
        }

        function createStars() {
          const stars = document.getElementById("stars");
          const random = seededRandomFactory();
          for (let index = 0; index < 48; index += 1) {
            const star = document.createElement("span");
            const size = 0.5 + random() * 1.25;
            const cool = random() > 0.58;
            star.className = "star";
            Object.assign(star.style, {
              left: `${random() * 100}%`,
              top: `${random() * 100}%`,
              width: `${size}px`,
              height: `${size}px`,
              opacity: String(0.18 + random() * 0.62),
              backgroundColor: cool ? "rgb(125 211 252)" : "white",
            });
            stars.append(star);
          }

          const rays = document.getElementById("rays");
          for (let index = 0; index < 28; index += 1) {
            const ray = document.createElement("span");
            ray.className = "ray";
            ray.style.width = `${8 + ((index * 7) % 18)}px`;
            ray.style.transform = `rotate(${(index * 137.5 + 11) % 360}deg)`;
            ray.style.setProperty("--delay", `${-((index * 0.37) % 3.6)}s`);
            ray.style.setProperty("--duration", `${2.1 + ((index * 17) % 13) / 10}s`);
            rays.append(ray);
          }
        }

        function setText(id, value) {
          document.getElementById(id).textContent = typeof value === "string" ? value : "";
        }

        function renderData(data) {
          const quota = resolveMarketingQuota(data, document.documentElement.lang || "en-US");
          if (quota) data = { ...data, ...quota };
          setText("plan-name", data.planName);
          setText("amount-value", data.amountValue || data.amountLabel);
          setText("amount-unit", data.amountUnit);
          setText("expiry-prefix", data.endsAtPrefix);
          setText("expiry-value", data.endsAtLabel || "—");
          replay.setAttribute("aria-label", data.replayLabel || "Replay");
          const benefits = document.getElementById("benefits");
          benefits.replaceChildren();
          const values = Array.isArray(data.benefits) ? data.benefits : [];
          values.forEach((value) => {
            if (typeof value !== "string") return;
            const row = document.createElement("div");
            row.className = "benefit";
            // 原字符占位不等同于权益图标；只克隆包内固定 SVG，不解析远端 HTML。
            const icon = document
              .getElementById("benefit-icon-template")
              .content.firstElementChild.cloneNode(true);
            const text = document.createElement("span");
            text.className = "benefit-text";
            text.textContent = value;
            row.append(icon, text);
            benefits.append(row);
          });
        }

        function setPressure(x, y, down) {
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-transition-duration", "140ms");
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-rx", `${-y * 4}deg`);
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-ry", `${x * 5}deg`);
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-x", `${((x + 1) / 2) * 100}%`);
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-y", `${((y + 1) / 2) * 100}%`);
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-depth", down ? "-12px" : "-5px");
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-scale", down ? "0.98" : "0.995");
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-shadow-x", `${-x * 8}px`);
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-shadow-y", `${18 - y * 3}px`);
        }

        function resetPressure() {
          hovered = false;
          pressed = false;
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-rx", "0deg");
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-ry", "0deg");
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-x", "50%");
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-y", "50%");
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-depth", "0px");
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-scale", "1");
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-shadow-x", "0px");
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-shadow-y", "18px");
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-transition-duration", "280ms");
        }

        function replayHero(emitAction = true) {
          ticketFlip.getAnimations().forEach((animation) => animation.cancel());
          resetPressure();
          idleStartsAt = performance.now() + ENTER_DURATION;
          ticket.dataset.idlePressure = "waiting-for-entry";
          ticketFlip.classList.remove("is-entering");
          void ticketFlip.offsetWidth;
          if (!reducedMotion) ticketFlip.classList.add("is-entering");
          const galaxy = document.querySelector(".galaxy");
          galaxy.style.animation = "none";
          void galaxy.offsetWidth;
          galaxy.style.animation = "";
          if (instanceId && emitAction) {
            parent.postMessage({ channel: CHANNEL, type: "action", instanceId, id: "replay" }, "*");
          }
        }

        function animateIdle(now) {
          animationFrame = 0;
          if (!reducedMotion && now >= idleStartsAt && !hovered) {
            ticket.dataset.idlePressure = "active";
            const raw = ((now - idleStartsAt) / 5200) * CORNERS.length;
            const progress = ((raw % CORNERS.length) + CORNERS.length) % CORNERS.length;
            const index = Math.floor(progress);
            const next = (index + 1) % CORNERS.length;
            const rawOffset = progress - index;
            const offset = rawOffset * rawOffset * (3 - 2 * rawOffset);
            const x = CORNERS[index][0] + (CORNERS[next][0] - CORNERS[index][0]) * offset;
            const y = CORNERS[index][1] + (CORNERS[next][1] - CORNERS[index][1]) * offset;
            ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-transition-duration", "80ms");
            ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-rx", `${-y * 8}deg`);
            ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-ry", `${x * 10}deg`);
            ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-x", `${((x + 1) / 2) * 100}%`);
            ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-y", `${((y + 1) / 2) * 100}%`);
            ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-depth", `${-10 - Math.abs(x * y) * 2}px`);
            ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-scale", "0.975");
            ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-shadow-x", `${-x * 22}px`);
            ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-shadow-y", `${20 - y * 11}px`);
          }
          scheduleIdle();
        }

        function scheduleIdle() {
          if (
            !animationFrame &&
            instanceId &&
            !reducedMotion &&
            document.documentElement.dataset.visible !== "false" &&
            !document.hidden
          ) {
            animationFrame = requestAnimationFrame(animateIdle);
          }
        }

        function updateVisibility() {
          cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrame);
          animationFrame = 0;
          const visible = document.documentElement.dataset.visible !== "false" && !document.hidden;
          ticketFlip.getAnimations().forEach((animation) => {
            if (!visible) animation.pause();
            else if (animation.playState === "paused") animation.play();
          });
          scheduleIdle();
        }

        ticketFlip.addEventListener("animationend", (event) => {
          if (event.target === ticketFlip && event.animationName === "ticket-enter") {
            ticketFlip.classList.remove("is-entering");
          }
        });
        document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", updateVisibility);

        ticket.addEventListener("pointerenter", () => {
          hovered = true;
        });
        ticket.addEventListener("pointermove", (event) => {
          if (reducedMotion) return;
          const bounds = ticket.getBoundingClientRect();
          if (!bounds.width || !bounds.height) return;
          const x = Math.max(
            -1,
            Math.min(1, ((event.clientX - bounds.left) / bounds.width) * 2 - 1),
          );
          const y = Math.max(
            -1,
            Math.min(1, ((event.clientY - bounds.top) / bounds.height) * 2 - 1),
          );
          setPressure(x, y, pressed);
        });
        ticket.addEventListener("pointerdown", () => {
          if (reducedMotion) return;
          pressed = true;
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-depth", "-12px");
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-scale", "0.98");
        });
        ticket.addEventListener("pointerup", () => {
          if (reducedMotion) return;
          pressed = false;
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-depth", "-5px");
          ticket.style.setProperty("--ticket-scale", "0.995");
        });
        ticket.addEventListener("pointerleave", resetPressure);
        ticket.addEventListener("pointercancel", resetPressure);
        ticket.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
          if (reducedMotion || typeof ticketFlip.animate !== "function") return;
          ticketFlip.getAnimations().forEach((animation) => animation.cancel());
          // 入场被点击打断不会触发 animationend，也必须恢复原生背面。
          ticketFlip.classList.remove("is-entering");
          const bounds = ticket.getBoundingClientRect();
          const direction = event.clientX < bounds.left + bounds.width / 2 ? -1 : 1;
          ticketFlip.animate(
            [{ transform: "rotateY(0deg)" }, { transform: `rotateY(${direction * 360}deg)` }],
            { duration: 720, easing: "cubic-bezier(0.22, 0.72, 0.18, 1)" },
          );
        });
        replay.addEventListener("click", () => replayHero());

        window.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
          if (event.source !== parent) return;
          const message = event.data;
          if (!message || message.channel !== CHANNEL || typeof message.instanceId !== "string") {
            return;
          }
          if (message.type === "init") {
            instanceId = message.instanceId;
            document.documentElement.dataset.theme = message.theme === "dark" ? "dark" : "light";
            document.documentElement.lang =
              typeof message.locale === "string" ? message.locale : "en";
            reducedMotion = message.reducedMotion === true;
            document.documentElement.dataset.reducedMotion = String(reducedMotion);
            renderData(message.data || {});
            replayHero(false);
            updateVisibility();
            parent.postMessage({ channel: CHANNEL, type: "ready", instanceId }, "*");
            return;
          }
          if (!instanceId || message.instanceId !== instanceId) return;
          if (message.type === "theme") {
            document.documentElement.dataset.theme = message.theme === "dark" ? "dark" : "light";
          } else if (message.type === "visibility") {
            document.documentElement.dataset.visible = String(message.visible);
            updateVisibility();
          } else if (message.type === "destroy") {
            cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrame);
            animationFrame = 0;
            document.documentElement.dataset.visible = "false";
            ticketFlip.getAnimations().forEach((animation) => animation.cancel());
            ticketFlip.classList.remove("is-entering");
            instanceId = "";
          }
        });

        createStars();
      })();
    </script>
  </body>
</html>

// 按单位分组，每组一次性优先；不同单位不相加。
function resolveMarketingQuota(data, locale) {
  if (!data.zcode_plan || typeof data.zcode_plan !== 'object') return null;
  const all = Array.isArray(data.zcode_plan.entitlements) ? data.zcode_plan.entitlements : [];
  const zh = locale.startsWith('zh');
  const compact = new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, { notation: 'compact', maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
  const normalize = value => {
    if (typeof value !== 'string' || !value.trim()) return 'tokens';
    const unit = value.trim();
    if (['token', 'tokens'].includes(unit.toLowerCase())) return 'tokens';
    if (['credit', 'credits'].includes(unit.toLowerCase())) return 'credits';
    return unit;
  };
  const label = (unit, daily) => `${unit === 'credits' && zh ? '积分' : unit}${daily ? (zh ? ' / 天' : ' / day') : ''}`;
  const byUnit = new Map();
  for (const e of all) {
    if (!e || e.meter !== 'model_usage' || typeof e.grant_units !== 'number' ||
        !Number.isFinite(e.grant_units) || e.grant_units < 0 || !['one_time', 'daily'].includes(e.period)) continue;
    const unit = normalize(e.unit_type);
    if (!byUnit.has(unit)) byUnit.set(unit, []);
    byUnit.get(unit).push(e);
  }
  const groups = [...byUnit].map(([unit, values]) => {
    const once = values.filter(e => e.period === 'one_time');
    const entries = once.length ? once : values.filter(e => e.period === 'daily');
    const daily = !once.length;
    return { entries, total: entries.reduce((sum, e) => sum + e.grant_units, 0), unit: label(unit, daily) };
  });
  const mixed = groups.length > 1;
  return {
    amountValue: mixed ? groups.map(g => `${compact.format(g.total)} ${g.unit}`).join(' + ') : new Intl.NumberFormat(locale).format(groups[0]?.total ?? 0),
    amountUnit: mixed ? '' : groups[0]?.unit ?? 'tokens',
    mixed,
    entries: groups.flatMap(g => g.entries),
    benefits: groups.flatMap(g => g.entries.map(e => `${typeof e.show_name === 'string' ? e.show_name : ''} · ${compact.format(e.grant_units)} ${g.unit}`)),
  };
}

// 新模板共用通信层；迁移的 Weekend 动效保留原通信实现，避免改变交互时序。
globalThis.ZCodeResource = {
  connect(render, dispose = () => {}, hover = () => {}) {
    const channel = 'zcode-cloud-hero-v1';
    let instanceId = null, state = {}, destroyed = false;
    const send = (type, extra = {}) => {
      if (instanceId) parent.postMessage({ channel, instanceId, type, ...extra }, '*');
    };
    const receive = event => {
      const m = event.data;
      if (destroyed || event.source !== parent || !m || m.channel !== channel || typeof m.instanceId !== 'string') return;
      if (instanceId && m.instanceId !== instanceId) return;
      if (m.type === 'init') {
        instanceId = m.instanceId;
        state = { theme: m.theme === 'dark' ? 'dark' : 'light', locale: typeof m.locale === 'string' ? m.locale : 'en-US', data: m.data && typeof m.data === 'object' ? m.data : {}, reducedMotion: m.reducedMotion === true, visible: true };
      } else if (!instanceId) return;
      else if (m.type === 'theme') state.theme = m.theme === 'dark' ? 'dark' : 'light';
      else if (m.type === 'hover') {
        // App 隔离 iframe 点击，hover 走可信宿主消息且不重渲染权益。
        if (typeof m.hovered === 'boolean') hover(m.hovered && state.visible && !state.reducedMotion);
        return;
      }
      else if (m.type === 'visibility') state.visible = m.visible === true;
      else if (m.type === 'destroy') { destroyed = true; removeEventListener('message', receive); dispose(); document.body.replaceChildren(); return; }
      else return;
      if (m.type === 'init' || !state.visible) hover(false);
      document.documentElement.dataset.theme = state.theme;
      document.documentElement.lang = state.locale;
      try { render(state); if (m.type === 'init') send('ready'); }
      catch { send('error', { code: 'render_failed' }); }
    };
    addEventListener('message', receive);
    return { action: id => send('action', { id }) };
  }
};

(() => {
  const rows = [
    ['repo.snapshotUpload = removed;', '仓库快照上传链路已移除', 'Snapshot upload removed'],
    ['incident.cloudData = deleted;', '涉事云端数据已删除，第三方核查确认', 'Deleted; 3rd-party verified'],

    ['  your code stays local;', '', ''],
    ['}', '', ''],
    ['', '', ''],
    ['openSource.version = v3.14.3;', '已更新至最新版', 'Updated to latest'],
    ['openSource.syncWith(official);', '今后同步发布', 'Synced releases'],
    ['', '', ''],
    ['if (you.paid || you.returningPaidUser) {', '1 个月内回归的付费用户同享', 'Return ≤1mo'],
    ['  gift("4 张周重置卡 + 4 张 5 小时重置卡");', '1 个月内有效', 'Valid 1 month'],
    ['}', '', ''],
    ['for (day in 09.28..10.07) {', 'ZCode 全体用户', 'All ZCode users'],
    ['  giveaway("1 亿 Token" * 10 万份);', '', ''],
    ['}', '', ''],
  ];
  const hero = document.getElementById('hero'), code = document.getElementById('code');
  const media = matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
  let animations = [], current, destroyed = false, hostVisible = true;
  function tokenized(text, container) {
    const re = /("[^"\n]*"|\b(?:if|for|in|removed|deleted)\b|\bv\d+(?:\.\d+)+|\b\d+(?:\.\d+)*|\b(?:gift|giveaway|syncWith)\b)/g;
    let end = 0;
    for (const match of text.matchAll(re)) {
      container.append(document.createTextNode(text.slice(end, match.index)));
      const span = document.createElement('span');
      span.className = match[0][0] === '"' ? 'string' : /^(?:v?\d)/.test(match[0]) ? 'number' : /^(gift|giveaway|syncWith)$/.test(match[0]) ? 'method' : 'keyword';
      span.textContent = match[0]; container.append(span); end = match.index + match[0].length;
    }
    container.append(document.createTextNode(text.slice(end)));
  }
  function stop() { animations.forEach(a => a.cancel()); animations = []; }
  function play() {
    stop();
    if (destroyed || current.reducedMotion || media.matches) return;
    [...code.children].forEach((el, i) => {
      animations.push(el.animate([{opacity:0,transform:'translateY(3px)'},{opacity:1,transform:'translateY(0)'}],{duration:360,delay:40+i*65,fill:'both',easing:'cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)'}));
    });
    visibility();
  }
  function draw() {
      stop(); code.replaceChildren();
      const en = !current.locale.startsWith('zh');
      document.getElementById('note').textContent = en ? 'A commitment to you' : '致每一位用户';
      document.getElementById('closing').textContent = en ? 'Trust cannot be reset with one click. We will earn it back, one improvement at a time.' : '信任不能一键重置。我们会用每一次改进，慢慢赢回来。';
      rows.forEach((_,index) => {
        const [source,zh,english]=rows[index];
        const row = document.createElement('div');
        if (!source) return;
        row.className = 'row' + (index >= 3 && index <= 6 ? ' local' : '') + (index === 3 ? ' local-start' : '') + (index === 6 ? ' local-end' : '');
        row.dataset.line = String(rows.slice(0,index+1).filter(r=>r[0]).length).padStart(2,'0');
        const text = document.createElement('pre'); text.className = 'source';
        let literal = source;
        if(en) literal = literal.replace('4 张周重置卡 + 4 张 5 小时重置卡','4 weekly + 4 5h reset cards').replace('"1 亿 Token" * 10 万份','"100M Tokens" * 100000');
        tokenized(literal,text);
        const comment = en ? english : zh;
        if(comment){
          const c=document.createElement('span');c.className='comment';
          if(index===11 && !en){
            c.classList.add('comment-leading');c.textContent='// '+comment;
            row.classList.add('has-leading-comment');text.prepend(c);
          }else{c.textContent='  // '+comment;text.append(c);}
        }
        row.append(text); code.append(row);
      });
      play();
  }
  function render(state) {
    hostVisible=state.visible;
    if(state!==current){current=state;draw();}
    visibility();
  }
  function visibility() {
    const visible = hostVisible && !document.hidden;
    animations.forEach(a => { if (!visible && a.playState === 'running') a.pause(); else if (visible && a.playState === 'paused') a.play(); });
  }
  function resize() { hero.style.setProperty('--scale',Math.min(innerWidth/480,innerHeight/360)); }
  const observer = new ResizeObserver(resize); observer.observe(document.documentElement);resize();
  const motion = () => { if(current) {play();visibility();} };
  media.addEventListener('change',motion); document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',visibility);
  ZCodeResource.connect(render,() => {destroyed=true;stop();observer.disconnect();media.removeEventListener('change',motion);document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange',visibility);});
})();

// Hero 与 Banner 共用：一次性优先，同周期叠加；未知周期不混入合计。
function resolveMarketingQuota(data, locale) {
  if (!data.zcode_plan || typeof data.zcode_plan !== 'object') return null;
  const all = Array.isArray(data.zcode_plan.entitlements) ? data.zcode_plan.entitlements : [];
  const eligible = all.filter(e => e && e.meter === 'model_usage' &&
    typeof e.grant_units === 'number' && Number.isFinite(e.grant_units) && e.grant_units >= 0 &&
    ['one_time', 'daily'].includes(e.period));
  const once = eligible.filter(e => e.period === 'one_time');
  const entries = once.length ? once : eligible.filter(e => e.period === 'daily');
  const daily = !once.length && entries.length > 0;
  const total = entries.reduce((sum, e) => sum + e.grant_units, 0);
  return {
    amountValue: new Intl.NumberFormat(locale).format(total),
    amountUnit: daily ? (locale.startsWith('zh') ? 'Tokens / 天' : 'Tokens / day') : 'Tokens',
    entries,
    benefits: entries.map(e => `${typeof e.show_name === 'string' ? e.show_name : ''} · ${new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, { notation: 'compact', maximumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(e.grant_units)} ${daily ? (locale.startsWith('zh') ? 'Tokens / 天' : 'Tokens / day') : 'Tokens'}`),
  };
}
